about: Shared cases of the seal of the content store (decision R104, documentation/Canonical Form.md, "The seal of the content store"). The TypeScript and the Rust implementation both read this file. A key is never stored as text: a case gives the byte that its key repeats ("keyByte", "keyLength" bytes, 32 when not given), and <key> in a text is the 64 small hexadecimal digits of that key, <KEY> the same in capital letters, built at run time. The HMAC cases are test cases 1 and 6 of RFC 4231. A difference case gives the files of the base and of the last commit, the texts of their objects by object id, the difference and its text. A check case gives a first-parent chain, newest first: each commit with its parents, its files and its seal ("own": a valid seal of the commit, "of <id>": the seal line of that other commit, copied, absent: no seal line), the mark of the copy before the check, the result and the mark after it (the check never writes it). A commit that a case does not list is not known: its files cannot be read, and it descends from nothing.
